comment: AI 639 comparison poses for the Terra & Mar edit prompts (AI 615-638). Blender config frame: metres, z up, front run A faces -Y, street z 0, base z 0.201. vfov_deg = vertical field of view (sensor fit VERTICAL). 'items' = the edit prompt ids a pose serves (render an item's evidence with items=<id>); 'group' = target | full | exterior | props | interior | check | final (the UHD 3840x2160 completion captures) | detail (close-ups for review, rendered at pct=200) | wear (close-ups of the wear and weathering features, 2026-10-14). Plain look-at cameras; the lighting is the file's own INSPECTION_RIG (the game's calibrated sky and sun, az 45 / el 55 from the front right). Poses with 'plan_camera' take their camera from the rebuild plan (rebuild/terramar_plan.json: CAM_B8 fitted to the plan with its lens shift, the orthographic top, the rear view); 'reference': 'b8' puts b8.png beside the pose's sheets (AI 643).
